'''Garhai''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of armor-plated [[Fish/Legends|fish]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]]. The planet's native [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] saw the garhai as a symbol of obedience and "dedication to enlightened leadership." Along with its twin symbol, the [[Spherical Flame]], this was considered one of the two most powerful symbols in Neimoidian culture and as such they were often displayed on the walls of Neimoidian buildings.<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> This included the grotto on Neimoidia where in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]]<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] first introduced his advisors, legal counsel [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]] and [[Deputy Viceroy]] [[Hath Monchar]] to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Gunray would later compare the fish to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems's]] [[manta droid subfighter]]s.
